description: NEMO is the Stockholm Environment Institute's Julia energy-system optimisation tool, distributed as NemoMod.jl. It contains least-cost supply and demand calculations, regional trade, storage, nodal power or pipeline flows, and emissions or renewable-target constraints. Inputs define the system, selected modelling years, costs and policy limits in a SQLite data store; outputs support comparison of least-cost configurations and operation. Geographic extent and time aggregation follow the user's regional and temporal definitions. Source is free under Apache-2.0 and supports open solvers such as HiGHS, with proprietary solvers optional. A limitation is that results depend on the chosen technology, network and policy assumptions. LEAP can provide a separate graphical interface under its own terms. The model supports energy-infrastructure expansion studies. PyPSA (model-pypsa) is a related optimiser. This SEI model is distinct from the Australian National Electricity Market Optimiser with the same acronym.
inputs: SQLite energy-system parameters, costs and constraints
